tools.name: deal_quick_check
tools.description: Run a deterministic, lender-grade quick check on a real estate deal. Use this whenever a user asks whether a specific property or deal works, pencils, is worth pursuing, what their maximum offer should be, or wants real numbers on a flip, a rental refinance, or a ground-up build. Inputs: deal_type (

tools.name: methodology_faq
tools.description: Answer questions about how Refpro works. Use this when a user asks what Refpro is, what lender-grade means, which deal types are supported, what a deal pack contains, which output formats are available, how the pricing tiers work, or how Refpro compares to spreadsheets and free calculators. Input: q

tools.name: sample_report_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a sanitized public sample section from Refpro's reference deal library. Use this when a user asks to see what a Refpro report or deal pack actually looks like, wants an example before signing up, or needs a reference for how a lender-ready underwriting package is structured. Inputs: deal_type

tools.name: deal_sheet_preview
tools.description: Fetch a sanitized example of Refpro's 1-Page Deal Sheet, the single lender-facing page a borrower hands to a lender. Use this when a user asks what a Refpro deal sheet looks like, what to hand or send a lender, or wants a one-page summary format for a flip, a rental refinance or a ground-up build. I

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: methodology_faq, sample_report_fetch, deal_sheet_preview · Public sink: deal_sheet_preview · Destructive: deal_quick_check, deal_sheet_preview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: methodology_faq, sample_report_fetch, deal_sheet_preview · Public sink: deal_sheet_preview · Destructive: deal_quick_check, deal_sheet_preview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
